title: Disjoint block choices
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type with decidable equality, let $R$ be a finite subset of $\alpha$, and let $d,t\in\mathbb{N}$. Define the type of ordered sequences of $t$ pairwise disjoint $d$-element subsets of $R$: for $t=0$ it has one element, and for $t+1$ an element consists of a $d$-element subset of $R$ together with such a sequence chosen from the elements of $R$ outside that subset.
